info.name: Library Management System API
info.description:
# Library Management System API (OpenAPI 3 / SpringDoc)

Comprehensive RESTful API for modern library operations, including:
* **Authentication**: Registration, JWT login, and password recovery.
* **Book Catalog**: Catalog browsing, ISBN lookups, and inventory statistics.
* **Book Administration**: Admin catalog ingestion, bulk imports, updates, and hard deletion.
* **Circulation & Loans**: Borrowing, checking in, renewals, overdue tracking.
* **Book Reviews**: 1-5 star ratings, textual critiques, and book average metrics.
* **Fines & Penalties**: Overdue fine assessment, waiver authorization, and payment orders.
* **Genres**: Hierarchical category taxonomy and catalog indexing.
* **Payments**: Razorpay and Stripe gateway checkout initiation, signature verification, and cancellation.
* **Reservations**: Hold queue management, automatic notifications, and loan fulfillment.
* **Subscriptions & Plans**: Tiered memberships, borrowing limits, automated expiration, and renewals.
* **Users & Profiles**: User directory listings and authenticated profile management.
* **Wishlists**: Patron reading wishlists and personal book hold planning.

### Authentication
All secured endpoints expect the JWT bearer token in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
```
Use the **Authentication -> Login** request to retrieve your token, which can be stored in the collection variable `token`.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Endpoints for user registration, login credential verification, and password recovery workflows.

request.description: Registers a new patron user in the system with encrypted password credentials and returns a signed JWT access token and user profile.

body.raw:
{
  "email": "alice.johnson@example.com",
  "password": "SecurePass123!",
  "fullName": "Alice Johnson",
  "phone": "+1-555-019-2834",
  "userName": "alice_j",
  "role": "ROLE_USER"
}

request.description: Validates the user's email and password against stored bcrypt hashes and returns an authenticated JWT session token.
Generates a secure password reset token associated with the provided email account and dispatches an email containing the reset link.
Validates the one-time password reset token, verifies that it has not expired, and sets the user's password to the new value.

item.name: 2. Books
item.description: Public and patron-facing endpoints for browsing, searching, and inspecting the book catalog.

request.description: Retrieves full bibliographic metadata, copy availability, and loan status indicators for a specific book ID.
Fetches a book's catalog details using its unique International Standard Book Number (ISBN-10 or ISBN-13).
Filters book titles by genre, availability status, and active status with configurable pagination and sorting.
Performs an advanced multi-attribute search across book catalog with keyword searchTerm, genreId, availability flags, and pagination.

body.raw:
{
  "searchTerm": "Clean Code",
  "genreId": 3,
  "availableOnly": true,
  "page": 0,
  "size": 20,
  "sortBy": "createdAt",
  "sortDirection": "DESC"
}

request.description: Returns summary counts of total active catalog titles and aggregate shelf copies available for circulation.
Deactivates a book title in the catalog (sets active = false) so it no longer appears in general searches.

item.name: 4. Book Loans & Circulation
item.description: Endpoints for borrowing, returning, renewing, and tracking book loan transactions.

request.description: Creates an active checkout loan for the authenticated patron. Validates active membership plan, max allowed concurrent loans, overdue debt, and book copy availability.
Allows circulation desk staff or administrators to initiate a book checkout on behalf of a designated patron by user ID.
Records the physical return of a borrowed book. Increments available inventory copies unless reported lost, marks loan as RETURNED, and computes any overdue penalties.
Extends the due date of an active loan by requested extension days if loan is not overdue and renewalCount has not reached maxRenewals.
Retrieves a paginated list of book loans associated with the logged-in user, optionally filtered by status (e.g., CHECKED_OUT, OVERDUE, RETURNED).
Performs an administrative search across all system book loans with filters for patron ID, book ID, loan status, date range, and overdue flag.

body.raw:
{
  "userId": 5,
  "bookId": 1,
  "status": "CHECKED_OUT",
  "overdueOnly": false,
  "unpaidFinesOnly": false,
  "startDate": "2026-10-01",
  "endDate": "2026-10-31",
  "page": 0,
  "size": 20,
  "sortBy": "createdAt",
  "sortDirection": "DESC"
}

request.description: Triggers a system-wide reconciliation job that scans active checked-out loans against current date and transitions past-due loans to OVERDUE status with calculated overdueDays.

item.name: 5. Book Reviews
item.description: Endpoints for patrons to submit, edit, read, and delete book ratings and written reviews.

request.description: Submits a rating (1-5) and written review text for a book. Each user can review a book at most once.
Updates the rating score or comment text of a previously submitted review. Only the original author or an administrator may update.
Removes a review from the database. Allowed for the review author or administrators.
Retrieves a single review by its primary identifier.
Returns a paginated list of reviews submitted for a specific book title with sort options.
Computes and returns the overall average star rating score and total count of reviews for a book.
Fetches a paginated history of all book reviews posted by the currently logged-in user.
Retrieves a paginated list of reviews written by a specific user identifier.

item.name: 6. Fines & Penalties
item.description: Endpoints for managing, calculating, settling, and waiving patron fines and overdue penalties.

request.description: Creates a new financial penalty associated with a specific book loan (e.g. for damage, loss, or special penalty).

body.raw:
{
  "bookLoanId": 101,
  "type": "DAMAGE",
  "amount": 2500,
  "reason": "Water damage on back cover pages 400-450",
  "notes": "Assessed during return inspection"
}

request.description: Generates a gateway checkout payment order to settle the outstanding balance of the specified fine ID.
Marks an assessed fine as WAIVED, records the waiving administrator ID, timestamp, and justification reason.
Retrieves all fines incurred by the currently logged-in user, optionally filtered by status (PENDING, PAID, WAIVED) or fine type.
Retrieves a paginated list of all system fines with optional filters for fine status, type, and specific user ID.

item.name: 7. Genres & Categories
item.description: Endpoints for managing book subject classifications and genre hierarchy.

request.description: Creates a new catalog genre with optional parent genre association for sub-categorization.

body.raw:
{
  "code": "SCI-FI",
  "name": "Science Fiction",
  "description": "Speculative fiction dealing with imaginative concepts such as futuristic science and technology.",
  "displayOrder": 1,
  "active": true,
  "parentGenreId": 1
}

request.description: Retrieves the full list of active genres including their nested sub-genres.
Retrieves details of a specific genre by its primary numeric identifier.
Modifies genre details such as display name, description, active status, or display order.

body.raw:
{
  "code": "SCI-FI-UPDATED",
  "name": "Science Fiction & Fantasy",
  "description": "Speculative fiction including sci-fi, fantasy, and futuristic narratives.",
  "displayOrder": 1,
  "active": true
}

request.description: Marks the genre as inactive (active = false) without removing historical book references.
Permanently removes the genre record from the database. Blocked if books or child subgenres are assigned to it.
Retrieves all root categories that have no parent genre assigned.
Returns the aggregate total number of active genre categories.
Calculates and returns the total number of books assigned to the specified genre ID.

item.name: 8. Payments & Transactions
item.description: Endpoints for payment gateway signature verification, transaction cancellation, and transaction auditing.

request.description: Validates Razorpay or Stripe checkout credentials, confirms fund settlement, updates fine or subscription status, and records the transaction receipt.
Cancels a pending payment transaction record and marks its status as CANCELLED.
Retrieves an administrative paginated log of all gateway payments across the system with sorting support.

item.name: 9. Reservations & Queue Holds
item.description: Endpoints for reserving currently checked-out books, managing hold queues, and fulfilling holds upon availability.

request.description: Places the current authenticated user into the reservation waiting queue for an unavailable book. Checks max active reservation limit (5) and active loan constraints.
Allows library staff to place a reservation hold for a specified patron ID.
Cancels an existing pending or available reservation. Can be triggered by the hold owner or by an administrator.
Transitions an available reservation hold into an active checkout loan for the patron when they pick up the book.
Retrieves a paginated list of reservations placed by the currently logged-in user with filter options.
Administrative search across all reservations with filters for patron ID, book ID, reservation status, and hold validity.

item.name: 10. Subscriptions & Memberships
item.description: Endpoints for purchasing, activating, managing, cancelling, and inspecting library patron subscriptions.

request.description: Creates a pending subscription for the user and initializes a gateway checkout order returning payment gateway details.
Retrieves an administrative list of all patron subscriptions across the library system.
Retrieves the currently active, unexpired subscription record for the logged-in user or a specified user ID.
Cancels an active subscription membership with an optional recorded justification reason.
Activates a subscription tier following verified completion of the associated payment transaction.
Triggers a batch update task that marks all subscriptions past their endDate as isActive = false.

item.name: 11. Subscription Plans
item.description: Endpoints for exploring available membership tiers and administrative management of pricing plans.

request.description: Retrieves all available subscription plans with pricing, loan limits, and borrowing duration allowances.
Retrieves promotional and highlighted plans (isFeatured = true) for display on the landing page.
Creates a new subscription tier with specified price, duration in days, max books allowed, and loan limits.

request.description: Deactivates a subscription plan (sets isActive = false) so new users cannot purchase it.

item.name: 12. Users & Profiles
item.description: Endpoints for viewing user directory information and managing patron profile accounts.

request.description: Fetches the full profile details of the user identified by the current JWT security authentication context.
Retrieves a summary list of all registered library patron and administrator user accounts.

item.name: 13. Wishlist & Reading Lists
item.description: Endpoints for managing saved books in a patron's personal reading wishlist.

request.description: Saves a book to the current authenticated patron's personal wishlist with optional reading notes. Duplicates are rejected.

item.name: Remove Item from Wishlist by ID

request.description: Removes a saved book item from the authenticated patron's wishlist using the wishlist entry ID.

item.name: Remove Book from Wishlist by Book ID

request.description: Removes a book from the current patron's wishlist using the target book's identifier.
Returns a paginated list of books in the authenticated user's wishlist, including inventory availability status.

item.name: Get All Items in My Wishlist (List)

request.description: Retrieves the complete unpaged list of all books saved in the patron's wishlist.
Returns a boolean flag { inWishlist: true|false } indicating whether the target book has already been added to the authenticated patron's wishlist.
Calculates and returns the aggregate count of wishlist items saved by the currently logged-in user.
